extracted.name: California Farm Chocolate Hazelnut Croissants
extracted.description: Mixing pure cacao powder and ground fresh hazelnuts and the butter that makes these croissants fluffy, you get one tasty chocolate croissant dessert. I added homemade hazelnut butter with cacao powder to our regular family breakfast croissant recipe. The hazelnut chocolate paste recipe is in our cookpad list. Don’t despair about this recipe having one more step than usual. It repeats the same simple steps for a showstopper result. Every step makes the croissant fluffier.
ingredient_lines: A) Make the croissant froth, use whisk attachment on dough maker
B) Make the croissant dough, use doughhook on dough maker
C) Mix the chocolate hazelnut butter with the croissant butter
16 Tsp Nutella hazelnut cacao paste spread (see cookpad recipe)
D) Roll and cut the croissants, use rolling pin:
Tbs Flour to dust working surface
E) Eggwash the croissants before baking
instruction_lines: A) With whisk attachment to dough maker, froth cold water, 2 fresh farm eggs, 25 grams sugar, 2 1/2 tsp dry yeast, all-purpose flour, 4 minutes.

B) with doughhook attachment to dough maker, make croissant dough, 8 minutes. Add flour, milk powder, sugar, salt, molten butter. Put between two pieces of wax paper, freeze an hour, then keep in fridge overnight.

C) with rolling pin, flatten the butter between two sheets of wax paper. Remove top paper, Distribute16 teaspoons of chocolate hazelnut butter(homemade or Nutella) on top of flattened butter, cover with wax paper roll out to smooth film, put in freezer one hour, then keep in fridge overnight

D) shape: dust with flour. Roll dough to 12”x12” square, put 8”x8” chocolate butter square in center, chocolate coating down, fold edges of dough over butter. Then fold in half to 8”x4”: roll out to 12” x 12”, rest in fridge on floortile 1 hour. Repeat dusting, folding, rolling and resting three more times with one hour intervals. Then, cut dough with knife in 6”x6” squares, then 3”x6” rectangles, then 3”x6” pizza slices on the diagonal. You now have 16 slices.

E) roll each pizza slice from base to tip, let rise one hour, bake at 375F on mexican floortile, two breadpans underneath to catch dripping butter, bake twenty minutes, serve, or freeze. Reheats in 30 seconds in microwave, tastes just like fresh.
